description: This file contains test cases for the FlaskTemplate class within a project generation framework. It uses pytest to set up fixtures for temporary directory creation, mock template structure, and project configuration. The tests verify project initialization, template information extraction, post-processing execution, configuration loading, and template variable replacement, all related to generating Flask-based projects.

classes.name: ProjectType
classes.description: Enum representing project types, including Flask.

classes.name: TemplateInitInfo
classes.description: Data class holding template initialization information such as commands and configurations.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: Main class responsible for initializing projects based on templates and configurations.

classes.name: FlaskTemplate
classes.description: Template class for generating Flask-based projects, providing methods like get_init_info().

methods.name: test_project_initialization(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Tests the process of initializing a Flask project and verifies the generated files and content.

methods.name: test_flask_init_info(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Checks that the template's get_init_info method correctly retrieves commands and configuration details.

methods.name: test_post_processing_execution(template_dir, project_config, temp_dir)
methods.description: Verifies that post-processing scripts are executed successfully and the expected side effects occur.

methods.name: test_config_file_loading(temp_dir)
methods.description: Ensures configuration can be loaded correctly from a JSON file.

methods.name: test_template_variable_replacement(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Tests whether template placeholders are properly replaced with project configuration values.
